newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares rise on dollar, outpace Europe.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares rise on dollar, outpace Europe.

text.p: A strong dollar and a fresh injection of cash by funds halted a four-session slide on the Oslo bourse and sent the cyclic shares rebounding, dealers said.
Norway's Total share index outpaced most of the top European bourses to close 1.98 percent up at 1,076.31 points. Turnover was a healthy 1.01 billion crowns, up more than four percent from Monday.
"It's a dollar day without a doubt. There also appears to be a new inflow of capital from the mutual funds," said one broker. "Watch the cyclicals, that's where the money's going."

Industrial heavyweight Norsk Hydro received a healthy jolt out of the recent downtrend and advanced eight crowns, or 2.4 percent, to 344.50 crowns. The company was the most traded share in value terms at 169 million crowns.
Insurer Storebrand continued on an upward path and gained 0.40 crowns to 45.50 crowns in 68.5 million crowns of trade.
Norway's largest insurance group, which recently has gained strongly on buying interest from an unknown purchaser, is due to release 1996 results at 0800 gmt on Wednesday.
